invoice.instructions: Extract billing header metadata and the final total payable from the invoice. Distinguish the supplier/vendor issuing the invoice from the billed recipient, and distinguish the final total amount due from subtotals, taxes, discounts, or individual line items.

invoice_number.label: Invoice number
invoice_number.description: Unique invoice identifier printed on the invoice (not purchase order number, account number, or reference code).

issue_date.label: Issue date
issue_date.description: Date the invoice was issued (not the payment due date or service period dates).

due_date.label: Due date
due_date.description: Payment due date for the invoice (not the issue date).

vendor_name.label: Vendor name
vendor_name.description: Legal or business name of the supplier issuing the invoice (not the customer / Bill To recipient).

total_amount.label: Total amount
total_amount.description: Final grand total / amount due on the invoice including tax and adjustments (not subtotal, tax line, or individual line-item totals).

lease.instructions: Extract key residential or commercial lease terms. Distinguish the tenant/lessee from the landlord/lessor, and distinguish recurring monthly base rent from security deposit, late fees, or aggregate annual figures.

tenant_name.label: Tenant name
tenant_name.description: Name of the tenant / lessee renting the premises (not the landlord, property manager, or guarantor).

monthly_rent.label: Monthly rent
monthly_rent.description: Recurring base monthly rent amount (not the security deposit, annual total, or late fee).

security_deposit.label: Security deposit
security_deposit.description: Refundable security deposit required under the lease (not monthly rent or pet/application fees).

lease_start.label: Lease start
lease_start.description: Commencement / start date of the lease term (not the execution/signature date or lease end date).

term_months.label: Term (months)
term_months.description: Total duration of the lease term expressed in months (numeric count only).

market_report.instructions: Extract headline rental-market metrics for the primary reporting period and geography. Distinguish current-period headline figures from prior-year comparisons, submarket benchmarks, or other unit types (studio/2BR).

report_quarter.label: Report quarter
report_quarter.description: Reporting quarter and year covered by the report (e.g., Q3 2025).

market_area.label: Market area
market_area.description: Primary geographic market or metro area covered by the report.

vacancy_rate.label: Vacancy rate
vacancy_rate.description: Current headline vacancy rate percentage for the market area (not occupancy rate or prior-year rate).

average_rent_1br.label: Average 1BR rent
average_rent_1br.description: Average monthly rent specifically for one-bedroom (1BR) units (not studio, 2BR, or overall blended average).

year_over_year_rent_growth.label: YoY rent growth
year_over_year_rent_growth.description: Year-over-year (YoY) percentage change in rents (not quarter-over-quarter change or vacancy change).

median_household_income.label: Median household income
median_household_income.description: Median annual household income reported for the market area.
